stem_book: What is the radius of curvature of the parabola traced out by the projectile in the previous problem at a point where the particle velocity makes an angle θ/2 with the horizontal?
derived: u²cos²θ/(g cos³(θ/2)) (assuming launch speed u at angle θ)
reason: Refers to a projectile in 'the previous problem' that is not printed (previous Q is about a clock); the manifest's launch data were invented by the transcriber
work: v cos(θ/2) = u cosθ ⇒ ρ = v²/(g cos(θ/2)) = u²cos²θ/(g cos³(θ/2))
